When Belle feels the stench of death approaching, her flames of vengeance burn hotter—hot enough to burn even her pain away. If her remaining HP percentage is below 50%, she is attacked, and takes damage that exceeds 30% of her max HP, the exceeding amount of damage is cut by 100%.

Additionally, if she is attacked, and her remaining HP percentage falls below 50%, this skill takes the damage from the enemy that attacked her that exceeds 30% of her max HP, and grants that amount to Belle as a [Shield] for 3 turns.
The max damage Belle takes becomes equal to 20% of her max HP, and the size of her [Shield] becomes equal to the damage from the enemy that attacked her that exceeds 20% of her max HP.

exclusiveEffects.text: Strengthens Piercing Shot. The targets of this skill become 5 random enemies.
Strengthens Cursed Bullet. The targets of this skill become 3 random enemies.
Strengthens Piercing Shot. The numbers of turns of [Bleed] and [Regeneration] each become 4.

levels.text: Dian sees precisely where the enemies’ weak points are and fires. Deals 1 physical attack equal to 380% of her ATK to 3 random enemies, and inflicts [Bleed] on all targets for 3 turns. Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Bleed] deals damage equal to 25% of Dian’s ATK.
The physical attack’s damage becomes equal to 410% of her ATK.
Additionally grants [Regeneration] to her for 3 turns. Each turn, at the start of the action phase, [Regeneration] restores HP equal to 5% of Dian’s max HP to her.

As Dian researches cursed creatures, she also gains their power. Activates when her remaining HP percentage is 40% or higher. Dian deals damage equal to 35% of her max HP to herself, and deals 1 direct attack equal to 60% of the depleted HP to 2 random enemies. If Dian does not fulfill the activation requirement, she instead deals 1 basic attack.
The direct attack’s damage becomes equal to 75% of the depleted HP.
The direct attack’s damage becomes equal to 85% of the depleted HP.
The direct attack’s damage becomes equal to 100% of the depleted HP.

Dian provides support with all her heart and devotion. At the start of the battle, this skill increases the chance to evade of both her and the ally with the highest ATK by 30%. Dian is enhanced by this skill for 4 turns, and the other target for 3 turns.
The number of turns of [Increased Chance to Evade] becomes 6 for Dian, and 5 for the other target.
The increase in all targets’ chance to evade becomes 50%.

In order to save as many friends as she can, even if must act alone, Dian stays on the battlefield until the very end. If Dian is attacked, and her remaining HP percentage falls below 40% while the number of allies who are alive is 2 or more, this skill grants [Invisibility] to Dian (cannot be dispelled). At the start of each turn or when an ally is defeated, if the number of allies who are alive becomes 1 or less, [Invisibility] is dispelled. This skill activates only 1 time per battle.

Additionally strengthens her basic attack. When she deals a basic attack, she instead deals 1 physical attack equal to 250% of her ATK to 2 random enemies, and has a 50% chance to dispel 1 buff from each target. At the start of each turn or when an ally is defeated, if the number of allies who are alive becomes 1 or less, this buff is dispelled.
The chance to dispel a target’s buff becomes 100%.
